title: Activation and Retention Intelligence
description: Find the behaviors that predict customer success, explain why cohorts retain or churn differently, and measure feature adoption impact on retention and revenue — your AI Growth Analyst's lifecycle readout.
setup_prompt: Use Activation and Retention Intelligence for my AI Growth Analyst. With my reconciled growth data, apply my activation definition and cohort rules, compare retaining and churning cohorts with evidence, measure feature adoption impact on retention and revenue, correlate supporting feedback, and produce evidence-backed findings without claiming unproven causes.

setup_inputs.label: Reconciled Growth Data Foundation or equivalent model
Activation definition, cohort keys, and retention windows
Feature and flag inventory with launch dates
Revenue linkage scope and plan mapping
Support, chat, review, and survey sources
Minimum freshness, coverage, and confidence policy

recommended_tools.name: PostHog, Mixpanel, or Amplitude MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized cohorts, retention curves, and feature-adoption breakdowns behind a finding

recommended_tools.name: Intercom, Zendesk, or app-review MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized support conversations, reviews, and survey responses correlated with lifecycle analysis

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Persist lifecycle snapshots, cohorts, findings, and follow-up outcomes

pulse_focus.label: Technical review
focus_areas: Activation, cohort, censoring, and revenue-join integrity
review_when: A run fails, produces incomplete evidence, or a key metric becomes unreliable

pulse_focus.label: Architecture review
focus_areas: Lifecycle model, cohort joins, history, feedback linkage, and dashboard architecture
Ownership of definitions and downstream consumers
review_when: The workflow, integration, environment, scale, or operating policy changes materially

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether lifecycle insight explains retention and revenue outcomes
Actionability, measurement cost, and decision value
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Cohort divergence findings with attributed differences
